ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 25
   C. 17
   D. 27

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 66
   C. 17
   D. 34

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 49

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 24

13. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 4

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 12.5
   D. 6

16. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 5

17. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

20. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 6

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 30
   C. 42
   D. 90

22. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

23. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

24. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
